items.title: Edwin "Squirrel" Ashcraft Interview, 1961-08-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Maybe Tommy Thomas' or some of the joints that were then popular in that area. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. That's why I don't, I think that it wasn't until after Bud, Tesh, and the others had heard Louie...

ctx.x: Well, I'm saying that because he spent the night, darn near all night with us the night before listening to McPartland and the Pollock Band and talking about that and whistling and thinking about it. And later on in a couple of other Whiteman records, particularly the ones where he played with Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey on trumpet. They made some trio stuff. That riff comes back time and time again. But it's because it's a forced riff. It's almost that it's a pile driver effect.
On the beat? Ahead the beat?
